raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "run out"
  role subject "the user's TV licence"
  role time "30 November"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "move to"
  role subject "the user"
  role destination "the user's parents' place in Cork"
  role time "December"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a3 assumed
  relation "have a TV licence"
  role subject "the user's parents"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a4 assumed
  relation "watch live TV"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@q query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "receive a fine or letters"
    role subject "the user"
    role time "after moving"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "need to renew the TV licence"
    role subject "the user"
    role time "the last few weeks before 30 November"
    polarity affirmed
  end
